Scope: Apply the approved full-workbench reference preview to the production Avalonia UI without replacing engineering data or behavior
PreExistingWorkPreserved: All previous tests, documentation and dated evidence
Implemented: Ordinary Light header gradient #1876E9 to #1455B8, mist-blue workspace/sidebar and pale table headers
Immutable semantic brushes supply subtle toolbar/status gradients; other themes fall back to their own surfaces
Separate white 6 DIP rounded sidebar sections with 6 DIP gaps; removed the obsolete connecting divider visual and style
Nested field/wavelength cards retain their full outline; sidebar idle inputs have softer borders without replacing focus/error/disabled feedback
Sidebar form labels use normal weight in Light without reducing font sizes; all themes keep native editing and a reserved vertical-scrollbar column
Existing mapped semantic icons are used in all four icon packs, with regression assertions that no section resolves to the question-mark fallback
Selected Light document tabs have a white body, blue text and a 2 DIP lower line in the existing Dock template; tool tabs remain distinct
Light workspace side/bottom inset 5/6 DIP, lens-editor side/bottom inset 6 DIP, surface-properties header vertical padding 7 DIP
Status metrics use a Light minimum width of 96 DIP instead of 128, with real snapshot values and the existing status messages
All lens columns, material-row semantics, commands, optical calculations, saves and initial two-document behavior are retained

Tests.Note: This is a scoped UI/workspace regression. Stage counts and dedicated capture runs overlap and must not be added.

RenderedControlFixtures.Mechanism: Dedicated ReferenceWorkbenchLayoutTests processes with Skia/HarfBuzz and headless drawing disabled
RenderedControlFixtures.FixtureBoundaries: Not a full MainWindow: default File-page presentation is assembled from production factories, other category pages are fixture placeholders, and the complete production action matrix/native window buttons are not exercised by these images. Workspace panels and displayed engineering/status values come from a real blank WorkbenchApplication.
RenderedControlFixtures.ObservedLimitation: The collapsed field-card caption appears blank in the Dark headless composition image. A dedicated six-case probe without nested clipping produced the same observation; that probe was reverted, and the default Debug assembly was rebuilt byte-identically to the validated identity. This image alone does not establish a native-product defect or certify all Dark text rendering; no fix or native acceptance is claimed for that observation.

IntermediateResults: An initial test compilation used the ambiguous Controls.LocalIcon name and Assert.Single with a Where clause. Qualified the icon namespace/import and used the predicate overload; final builds have no warnings.

The first completed scoped run passed 38/39. Its only failure retained a 364 DIP section-width assertion from the old margins; replaced it with the actual parent bounds and kept finite-width/sidebar checks.
The seven-case composition/section run and subsequent 41-case focused run passed. Their TRX files remain local.

Visual inspection found a waves name absent from the bundled icon set and an insufficiently visible document selection line. Switched section symbols to existing, attributed cross-theme mappings and added the line to the existing Dock body, with assertions.

An earlier pair of scoped runs passed 237/237 and render runs passed 6/6. Inspection still found auto-hidden scrollbar overlays covering right-hand input/card arcs. Restored reserved scrollbar space, added viewport assertions, rebuilt both default configurations and reran final-v2/final-render checks. Earlier files are retained locally.

The later optional nested-clipping render probe passed 6/6 (reference-workbench-nested-clip.trx) but did not explain the Dark caption observation. Reverted the probe; the default Debug App assembly was rebuilt and verified byte-identical to the final-v2 validation snapshot.
Limitations: No full main/laboratory/numerical suite, new Zemax capture or optical-accuracy claim
No native manual desktop/window-button, multi-monitor DPI or ARM64 acceptance
No installer rebuild or installed-product replacement
DeliveryAtValidation: Default runnable Debug/Release application binaries updated; uncommitted working tree
